verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents an API Access & Keys feature and a developer guide for custom agent skills, indicating a public API surface exists, but probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec or llms.txt, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of API usage in the community evidence. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, independent developer confirmation of API usage, and full endpoint documentation beyond the single page.
